title: Estate and Successor Services Handbook: When the Successor Runway Starts in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Source of the dates.** For a Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case reclassified on the death of the last surviving borrower, three dates are read from the death notices on the borrower's occupancy profile under Occupancy and Residency Certification:

- the date of death;
- the date the death was documented;
- any earlier telephone report of the death.

The accepted death notice is the one that documents the death. Where more than one accepted death notice is on the profile, the one received most recently documents the death. Among accepted notices received on the same day, it is the one recorded later by its recorded date and time.

**Rule.** The runway start date depends on how the death reached Cedarline:

1. **Prompt telephone report.** Where the death was first reported by telephone and the accepted death notice was received no more than 10 calendar days after that telephone report, the runway starts on the date of the telephone report.
2. **Late documentation with no telephone report.** Where no telephone report was made and the accepted death notice was received more than 30 calendar days after the date of death, the runway starts 30 calendar days after the date of death.
3. **Every other case.** The runway starts on the date the accepted death notice was received.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical dates)

| Telephone report | Date of death | Accepted notice received | Runway starts |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 May | 30 April | 12 May (10 days after the call) | 2 May |
| 2 May | 30 April | 13 May (11 days after the call) | 13 May |
| none | 1 March | 31 March (30 days after death) | 31 March |
| none | 1 March | 15 April (45 days after death) | 31 March (30 days after death) |
| none | 1 March | 20 March | 20 March |

A telephone report made after the accepted notice was received means the death was not first reported by telephone. Since a telephone report was made, the second branch does not apply either, so the runway starts on the date the accepted death notice was received.
